purpose: Profile a larger training corpus after student128 failed to improve within-family multistate recovery. This qualifies data generation, not student accuracy.
source: All1383 sequence-audited, source-backbone-verified unused families. Preserve original512 training families,64 tuning,64 confirmation, external constructs and locked tests. Existing122 labels remain unchanged.
profile: Four new families per length bucket at deterministic length ranks0, floor((N-1)/3), floor(2*(N-1)/3), N-1; one longest existing teacher-labeled family per bucket as an independent implementation control. Select before new teacher outcomes.
embedding: Fresh frozen ESMC final normalized layer80, strictFP32, padded to128/256/384/512, batch8. Unload ESMC before loading teacher and AE. Do not substitute inherited float16 embeddings.
frame: Proper global CA alignment of verified full reference to cached CA, then each teacher conformation to the reference on mean valid-teacher pLDDT>=0.7 core. Fall back to all residues if core has fewer than max(32,ceil(L/2)) or is degenerate. No domain-specific alignment. Copy cached reference_z bit-for-bit.
eligibility: Same existing122 rule: mean teacher pLDDT>=0.8, at least max(32,ceil(L/2)) residues with mean pLDDT>=0.7,2..8 frozen contact states among coarse-valid teacher samples, mean contact-feature pair distance<=6A. Retain all16 draws, even invalid ones; no student-dependent filtering.
audit: Decode all16 teacher latents with the historical deterministic repeated reconstruction-noise recipe,3 AE steps. Store per-label CA-lDDT and validity. Report exact protein-weighted empirical and balanced-prior reconstruction; require mean CA-lDDT>=0.98 and valid>=0.99 for the complete eligible corpus before training. No filtering on decoder outcomes.
resource_gate: OneH200 profile first,20minute wall limit,18minute work cap; four-bucket old/new controls, finite outputs and peak reserved<=110GiB. Each subsequent shard uses the identical recipe with one control per bucket. New full generation requires a successful profile; no student training is authorized by this data profile alone.
interpretation: Teacher modes are training strata, not physical populations. AFDB references are predictions. Sequence exclusions are heuristic and inherited pretraining overlap remains unknown. Keep the unchanged native/external evaluation gates.
